reviewer: t5_runtime independent of implementation author runtime_contracts

tcp_fixture.lane: actual TCP; production response and streaming loop; controlled fixture store

review_focus: Each ASGI send checks the conservative local lease deadline and bounds its await by remaining lease time and the fixed10second write bound.
Renewal loss cancels even blocked response start/body/iterator; completed response cancels its renewer.
Cleanup joins cancelled children before closing the iterator, then awaits token-owned Redis release under an AnyIO shield.
Expired local lease cannot renew; failed Redisrenew zeroes deadline.
Redis admission happens before headers and fails closed with structured503.
limitations: Source TCP fixture has no shared lease; real Redis lease renewal/crossreplica admission is separately qualified after deployment.
